name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.network.NetworkEntryDetailsActivity
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When a user selects a captured request in BigBrother's network history, this screen shows the request and response details.
disableEffect: You will not be able to inspect individual network requests in BigBrother; the app's network connections continue to work.
